payload.title: Common-registry management (sites, site departments, suppliers, consumables) exists only in the farm remote under the farm-gated /sites mount, so the sensor and HR workspaces cannot maintain the sites they reference and HR's site-contact link sends members without farm to /unauthorized
evidence: web/shell/src/App.tsx:112-115 (/sites/* is mounted behind ProtectedRoute requiredModule="farm")
web/modules/farm-module/src/pages/setup/SetupPage.tsx:51-58 (registry tabs hard-wired to farm: 'Manage farm locations and sites')
web/modules/sensor-module/src/hooks/useLocationHierarchy.ts:52-55 (sensor reads registry sites but has no page to create or edit them)
web/modules/hr-module/src/pages/today/UnassignedSitesPanel.tsx:13-14 (HR Today sends users to the farm Sites tab to fix site contacts)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/ctl.ts:56-72 (Control & sensors configuration area has no registry entry)
payload.rule_violated: D1: Company is the umbrella over the common kinds of each module, so each owner module must own and manage its own sites, departments, suppliers and consumables.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-30, release R9.
